selection_rule: HP official source train/val IDs; HAR200/class train,50/class val; round-robin user/environment/activity groups with deterministic SHA256 seed42 order. Selected before training.
HAR_label_assumption: Five ordinary activity labels are weak clip-level Nonfall labels; no framewise fall-absence claim.
dedup_rule: Keep validation records fixed. Exclude any train content matching current validation or prior25 HAR diagnostic clips; deduplicate train content, stop on conflicting binary labels. No randomized resplit.
validation_selection_rule: Best weighted combined-source validation CE; patience10,max100. No test records used.
training: New randomly initialized official ResNet18 architecture; no old C weights or ImageNet weights.
comparison: B/gate bypassed. Both models on exactly same HP FallDetection val and selected HAR val. Fixed thresholds0.5 and original0.574872225522995; no threshold optimization.
scope_caveat: Old model used HP+ESP32; new model is HP-only mixed-source. This is not a controlled data-only ablation. Tasks/environments remain confounded.
